claims.text: PAYMENT_GATEWAY_URL was not set, and the app exits when a required setting is missing.
A config refactor moved payment settings to a new config map that the deploy did not mount.
The deploy did not mount the new config map, so PAYMENT_GATEWAY_URL was missing and the app exited on start.
orders-api 5.2 was deployed with a config map that no longer had PAYMENT_GATEWAY_URL.
